label: More such package and mode of possession: degree-indexed induction controls, checked (inference)
rule: Explicit finite interpretation over Bool and Fin 3 with natural-number degrees, checked by decision
meaning: One finite interpretation with the respect fixed by degree. It shows that the formal possession gap needs a degree-indexed respect (or the threshold quality 'being hot'), that the ordinary-comparative gap and the failure of the MORE_3 reading of 'more such' need only the respect of having some heat, that a stipulated MORE_4 reading of 'more such' holds in the same case, that the formal reading of 'nothing moves except as in act' fails at the degree-indexed respect where its inclusive reading holds, and that with MORE_3 as the frame comparative the member of the package that fails is the exceeding step at inclusive act while possession, reception and the formal bearer hold. A structural surrogate; it is not evidence that a premise is false of reality.
